nom: SUNDAY RILEY C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum

avis.texte: Love this project and have purchased it multiple times. Leaves skin feeling so fresh and smooth and smells great! Highly recommend!

Firstly, this type of packaging isn't there to trick you! The small container is airless to protect the serum from oxidation so it stays fresh longer. Vitamin C is a sensitive serum itself. Also it doesnt stick to the small bottle, easier to get all the product out. Id said thats a win. I've used this product for a year now and it sucks seeing it get negative reviews for deception. I love it! I personally love the citrus smell. My skin is brighter and youthful. Serum gives my skin its own natural glow as well with consistent use. I have sensitive, combination skin and my face has never reacted negatively. The big downsides for me are you have to use it everyday or just about and obviously the price. Which can also be said about a lot of other skincare.
The product is just okay! There are way cheaper products. This is not worth the amount of money it only lasted about 2.5 weeks. Not worth it. So much bottle so little product.

avis.titre: If you have oily/ combo skin...be cautious
avis.texte: I wanted to love this product....and usually I do not breakout easily at all, but this product is so heavy and feels oily on my face that it has caused me to breakout in the the two weeks of me using it. returning it immediately!

I loveee this product!! Of all the skincare products I actively use and have tried, this one probably has had the most visible impact on my skin. I'm in the 25-35 age range, have combination skin that leans dry, and can sometimes react to new products. I used to have a bit of an uneven skintone with a fair bit of redness (even after cutting dairy, which was a major contributor to the redness/inflamation). I first tried the less concentrated syrum version of this product and loved it enough to want the stronger option. Within one bottle my skin was quite literally smoother, had a more even texture, was brighter and no more redness! That was the first time I had honestly seen an undeniable improvement from a skincare product. It smells so nice (like oranges!) and has a wonderful smooth texture kind of like a thin lotion. It dries fast and doesn't leave any sort of sticky feeling like some vitamin c products tend to do. Out of curiosity, I took apart an empty bottle and the product is pumped from a small sealed bag which is keyyy for vitamin c. Vitamin c is unstable when exposed to air, light and heat so to maintain its effectiveness it must stay sealed and cool. I've heard that some people have a hard time with vitamin c causing a reaction but I've never had an issue with any of the products I've tried. So maybe it's just me but this hasn't bothered my skin at all. Any time I get a compliment on my skin I recommend this product and have hyped it up to all my friends lol the big

I took the bottle apart and what somebody else had taken a photo of in May 2025. The bottle weighs a lot making one thing there's more to it cutting it open. It's a very small amount of product for a very high price not enough vitamin C to make a difference, but it did create a glowing effect on my face

Let me start with saying this was a gift. Now, right to it: before you spend money on this, look into the very popular Vit C serum with ferulic acid. It's the world's most popular and with good reason. If you're willing to spend at this price point, spend a little more and get your every cents worrh. Also, learn about incredients—this one does not contain yhe best. The one I mentioned above (the app won't let me mention the brand), has a cheaper contender—below $50—with very similar ingredients. It, too is phenomenal and effective serum. One brand starts with skinceu….. and the other brand is time….. Both have L-Ascorbic Acid and ferulic acid. The latter, even at a cheaper price point, is more effective than this, and both leave your alin glowing. Perhaps I would have fell for this and even enjoyed it had I not known and tried better products beforehand, but alas, I'm an ingredient and skin care connoisseur.

So this is my first winter living in the Pacific North West. In late November after a particularly cold weekend, I noticed a patch of dry skin had formed underneath my eye. It resembled a dark sun spot on my fair skin. I tried several different creams but my skin was not healing. I started applying this serum twice per day, and within a week it was finally healing. I think the spot is barely noticeable now. The skin around my eyes feels more moisturized and my dark circles aren't as bad as before. I also love the way it smells.
Package was deceiving. Small bottle lasted me two weeks. Its unfortunate. Makes me not trust the comoany. The product is nice but didnt get to use it long enough to see results.

I liked this a lot and was planing to repurchase until it ran out suddenly. Opened the bottle to discover the tiny bag that had contained the miniscule amount of product in the first place). Wow. The bag is actually great from a freshness standpoint but I'd NEVER spend this amount again on it.

I've tried other vitamin C serums and they either smell weird, don't work, or give me huge red rashes on my face. This one works and is sensitive skin friendly! I never broke out one time. And it really makes a difference in the glow and eveness of my skin.

I think company should be ashamed for the packaging and how little product you get. Once product gets low pump goofs up making it extremely hard to get remaining product. Id say look into the Vichy or another brand. I noticed no difference after a whole bottle.

Though i did like the smell and feel after applying. After using for a few days i had an allergic reaction. My eyes and face became very puffy and swollen. If you have sensitive skin i do not recommend.

avis.titre: This product finally gave me results
avis.texte: Although it is a bit on the expensive side. It is worth every penny and a little goes a long way. 10/10 recommend.
Everytime i try something cheaper or trendier, I keep comjng back to this one. I just can't get with the rest now that I've had the best 😩.

I have been using this product from Sunday Riley for awhile. I can not be without this. What a difference this Vitamin C lotion makes. My skin and I both love it. Sunday Riley's products perform exactly like she says and are excellent
I am obsessed with this whole line. It has really turned my skin around!!!
wanted to see how much I had left, and was suprised to see a bag that the lotion is in.very small! Won't be buying again, didnt see any difference either...
Went through this product in less than three weeks and didnt even use it daily. The price per volume is a scam

This is a great product! Dont let the bad reviews about the packaging sway you. They dont understand how vitamin C needs to work! Vit C needs stability. Introducing it to air, light etc like a dropper or clear glass container will make it less potent and unstable over time. And the airless bag, and jar that blocks light is genious to keep the vita c stable and potent. Youre still getting your product because it says on the box how many fl oz you are getting. They cant lie about that or short you…..they would get sued. This also has brightened by skin. Love the consistency and moisturizing. Has irritated my skin or broke me out.

avis.titre: This does what it says it's going to do!!
avis.texte: One of the best Vitamin C serums on the market. THC Ascorbate is superior to regular Vitamin C. Its oil soluble, very stable, doesnt go bad for a much linger period of time. You dont need a heavy layer of this product. You wont smell like hot dog water like you do with regular Vitamin C. It also contains glycolic acid adding to the brightening effect. Helps to exfoliate your skin. Do your self a favor and buy the big bottle its much more cost effective. U only need one pump in the morning for it to do its job. I love Sunday Riley products…

For how expensive this is, they really need to design better packaging. The pump straw doesn't reach the bottom of the jar, so you struggle to get the last little bit out of this overpriced product. I went through this extremely fast - I have a small face and I still needed 2 pumps for thorough application. I only used this once a day and it lasted maybe a little over a month? The product overall seems fine - no pilling, no breakouts, felt good on the skin. But glad I didn't pay full price because this really is not a value for the money. Hoping I can get the last bit of it out of the bottle to make it until my new serum gets here 🤦🏼‍♀️

I never leave reviews but came here to warn others of the deceptive packaging of this product. While I thought the glass jar was small to begin with I was shocked when I finished the product after only very few uses. I unscrewed the top to find a tiny bag inside the jar that held the product. It looks like a trial size.
Have been using this vitamin C product for past 2 years. This product does exactly what it says. Can't be without it. Love the feel of the serum, but most important it works..

Like others said there is highly any product in the bottle. I'm glad I bought this on sale and didn't buy it regular price. Heck, even buying this on sale was too much. Save your money and buy another vitamin c product on the market!

I don't care about super stable but c formula, as they claimed, as I don't find it very effective. I had much better results with vit c ampules from different brand. And the last thing, the price is outrageous for this product. I purchased it with 50 percent of discount during Ulta event and still thing I would better stick with my usual moisturizer instead of this thing. It's very average moisturizer, that's what it is.
Just recently switched to this and it smells good doesn't feel heavy or greasy and my skin seems to really feel and look better.

This product is a rip off. I went through a bottle in 3 weeks, and when i opened it to see if the pump was broken THERE IS JUST A TINY BAG OF PRODUCT AND THEY DONT FILL THE ACTUAL BOTTLE. Incredibly disappointed on this misleading size and blantant waste of material to make a large thick glass bottle.

I love this serum. It makes my skin feel so good, I wish I had discovered it sooner. In the summer I could just wear this after cleansing and it would feel enough. Last winter, my skin was so dry. This winter, since I've been using this awesome serum and a related moisturizer, my skin hasn't dried out. Highly recommend! I bought during the recent sale and gifted one to my sister!

This product contains Limonene, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Sweet Orange) Peel Oil, and Citrus Tangerina (Tangerine) Peel Oil. All three are photosensitizing! Bad news if you wear this serum in sunlight -- even with sunscreen over it, not a good idea. Your skin may have a minor chemical-peel like reaction and/or develop brown spots. They are are fairly high up in the ingredients list, meaning a higher percentage amount in formulation than if they were just there for fragrance (which isn't great to have in your face products, either). I don't know why skincare companies are allowed to use these ingredients without a warning on the label, but anyway, don't use this in the daytime if you'll be outside, and proceed with caution in general if you have sensitive skin.
Great brighter, serum, I can see results after just one week, definitely would buy again, the only thing I would say is it's a little greasy when I put it on

avis.titre: unfortunately it gave me an itchy and burning rash
avis.texte: I'm so disappointed because I love the other products, especially CEO Glow but this gave me a bumpy rash that itches and burns. I've read it doesn't bother some people which is great but unfortunately it didn't work for me. hopefully my bumps will be gone soon.
I have used other products by this brand and loved them. This one caused breakout after 3 days of use. Had to discontinue.
Love this brightening serum - use it every day as a nase layer. Love Sunday Riley products

The person who posted the super long negative comment complaining about the bottle being deceptive doesn't know what they're talking about. Sunday Riley is not trying to cheat people on the quantity of product. There is the proper amount of product in the bottle. The reason there in a pouch inside the bottle is to prevent the product from coming into contact with oxygen and oxidizing. Vitamin c in particular is sensitive to oxidation. The reviewer asked why would they use such a pretty glass bottle only to put a bag inside it. Well, people don't like to buy products in cheep looking plastic bags. They want lux packaging and will complain if they feel the component is cheep looking or feeling. Therefore, companies use heavy glass components when they are really unnecessary.

avis.titre: Love the system, Hate the Price

I think the products are way too expensive for what you get. And, the packaging makes it difficult, maybe impossible to tell how much product you have left.

I have sensitive, fair skin and have a very in-depth skincare routine. I ran out of my vitamin C serum I got in South Korea, so I was on the lookout for a new one. I used the whole bottle, religiously putting it on every morning after my essence followed by my moisturizer then sunscreen. I wait a few minutes between putting on each product, so it sets into the skin. I notice it leaves my skin feeling a bit greasy. I started getting little breakout, which was unusual for me, then my skin looked dull a few weeks later. Once I started the TruSkin Vitamin C Sreum, after a week my skin started looking brighter again so it was definitely the CEO serum. This is not for everyone, I would use a sample size to see how your skin reacts before committing to a bigger size, especially with the price.

avis.titre: didn't work for me, too pricey to give it a lot of time
avis.texte: I gave this a good shot for several weeks, and I didn't notice anything much different in my face. so I went back to my Obagi which is L ascorbic delivery of vitamin C. I now use the leftovers of this on my arms and back of hands.

Honestly, I am sad. I spent an afternoon inside a specialty store testing, reading and smelling dozens of products to find the 'one' for me. After a very long time, I settled on this C.E.O. Brightening Serum with such excitement. I took it home and used it that very night and continued every day and night until suddenly, yes, suddenly, the pump wasn't putting out very much product. I thought maybe it was clogged and tried to remove the top to run hot water through it. Then I turned over the bottle and noticed that what I thought was a full bottle of product was actually a facade, a fake. The bottle was glass and it had a fake interior that still didn't even have the product, it had another pouch inside that tiny interior glass area that had the product inside. Why would a brand/company make a beautiful large bottle only to hide the product two layers inside? Truly, you have the bottle, which is thick to start with as it's glass. Then you have this empty area inside that which is just glass with a smaller hole inside. Inside that smaller hole.... is a bag or pouch that has the product. I really loved the product for the short amount of time I had it before it was gone. Customers are just looking for good, credible products and when you do something like this as a company, you suffer, because you have now lost many customers who would have bought many other products but won't now over lack of integrity by the company. The product may have been good over time but I wont know bec

Spent over $600 in Sunday Riley Products and there has been no change in my skin. In fact my wrinkles are worse. If you used two like it says you can use you couldn't add this stuff. VERY DISAPPOINTED! And the packaging is wasteful!

avis.titre: There's nothing wrong with the packaging…
avis.texte: Decent serum. I tried the 0.5-oz travel size to see if I liked it before committing to a larger bottle. It was effective, so I give it 4 stars, but I didn't like the artificial orange smell so I won't be going back for more. If you like the smell, if you like THD as your vitamin C and if you have the budget for $90/ounce you'll be pleased. I noticed the bag inside the bottle when I opened the component to scrape out any excess (there are always multiple uses left in a pump bottle after it stops pumping!) and I'm surprised to see all the accusations about the brand shorting customers. The size of a bottle is irrelevant, you pay for the volume of product which is clearly labeled on the bottle. The amount of product in my travel size container was definitely 0.5-oz as indicated. That's half of a standard sized shot glass, it's not a lot. The bag looks small when empty because it's airtight and collapses to help push product up the pump. No one's getting scammed, it's just an expensive product per fluid ounce and an ounce goes by in a flash if you're using 2-3 pumps daily.

avis.titre: Deceptive packaging make this a no for for me
avis.texte: Although I like this Vitamin C serum the packing is very disappointing for the price. Tiny little bag inside a bigger bottle, not cool and very deceptive. Ran out in a couple weeks of use. Will be looking for another brand for my Vitamin C needs.

avis.titre: Deceptive packaging and less product than promised!
avis.texte: I tried this as part of the "Wake Up with Me" morning routine kit. Don't be fooled by the bottle that promises 0.5 fl oz of Sunday Riley's CEO Serum. If you open the bottle you'll find a hidden bag that steals a significant portion of the advertised amount. I found this out after the serum ran out much more quickly than expected. Now I know why. Sunday Riley's deceptive packaging is very disappointing. It's wrong to deceive customers into thinking they're receiving the full amount of serum advertised. It definitely ruined my trust in the brand's integrity. While I did like the serum and thought it was effective, this shady practice (along with poor customer service) is enough to steer me clear of future purchases. Buyers beware: what you see may not be what you get.

Nothing special like someone else said, not to mention such a thick container only for my husband to accidentally drop it and it broke. The problem is they only have a tiny portion of product in a bag within the big container. It's a rip off.

Such a nice vitamin C serum to brighten your skin and even out your skin tone. I love the packaging and pump dispenser. No weird smells either. Gifted by Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest review.

This was gifted by Sunday Riley. I did not see much change after using it daily for a week. I have combination skin and in some sensitive areas, there was some stinging sensation when initially using this. I can't recommend it as I did not see any significant brightening effect.

Gifted by Sunday Riley Smell is good and easy to absorb in my face. I tried 6 days ago and I'm seeing a lot of difference for my skin. Brightens and lightens without feeling greasy. It helps with hydration for sure and gives me glowing supple skin! Highly recommend it, keeps my skin glowing!

avis.titre: A nice addition to your routine.
avis.texte: Gifted by Sunday Riley, it's a nice addition to your morning routine to incorporate some vitamin C. My skin didn't react badly to it which is amazing. My skin doesn't look dull and looks fresh instead.

Sunday Riley Vitamin C Brightening Serum, gifted by Sunday Riley,is one of the best vitamin C serums in my opinion. This serum has a quite light texture, comparing to other vitamin C serums that I used. And this serum works really well, with significant effectiveness in 2 weeks time.

Gifted by Sunday Riley. I use this product twice a day. It's a gentle formula and I have sensitive skin. I has a refreshing citrus scent. I like using this with Good Genes All-In One Lactic Acid Treatment. This product makes my skin glow. It brightens and tightens. Would recommend!

One of my favorite products ever! Instantly brightens when applied and melts into the skin. I've been loving using this product day and night. Plus the scent is so fresh and clean! Gifted by Sunday Riley.

My pump stopped working and I tried to fix it. When I was able to get the pump out (which was extremely difficult) I was absolutely STUNNED at what I saw😡 a tiny little bag connected to the pump!!! Picture included! I had only used this 7 times / one pump! I love this product but not happy with a company who would do this to a loyal customer!

Kindly gifted by Sunday Riley. I have been using vitamin C serums for years (you know, the expensive one!) so I was happy to receive C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum from Sunday Riley. And guess what? It's amazing! It made my skin feel beautiful and glowy!

This was gifted by Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest review. I love testing out new vitamin C serums, because I feel like they are one of the most beneficial ingredients in my routine! I am happy to report that I really enjoyed this, it feels nice on the skin and I do feel like it's brightened my skin!
